notes: Run in an isolated slopsentral worktree with one stable shell-invokable check specification.
The benchmark may change only local files and must not publish or modify remote state.
Astra-targeted definition; static validation and golden replay are not a live model benchmark result.
setupQuestions: Which small repository invariant has a deterministic shell-invokable oracle?

scenarios.title: Executable-check red-green proof
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether a repository invariant is test-driven with the same stable command and an intended RED signal before implementation.
scenarios.userInput: Use Engineering Baseline in this isolated workspace. Add one repository policy that rejects duplicate manifest names. Prove the missing behavior with a stable shell-invokable RED check, implement the narrow fix, and rerun the same check GREEN. Do not commit, push, open or update a pull request, or otherwise modify remote state.
successChecklist: RED and GREEN use the same working directory, command, controlled inputs, and meaningful environment.
The RED signal is the intended missing behavior, not an infrastructure or syntax failure.
The narrow implementation passes the focused check and source graph validation.
